name: expanso-fleet
description: See and control your Expanso fleet from ChatGPT: dashboards, jobs, pipelines, and nodes.

interface.shortDescription: Dashboards and control for your Expanso fleet
interface.longDescription: Open a Fleet view with dashboards for your Expanso workspaces, mention jobs and nodes with @, ask why a job is degraded, and deploy, edit, stop, rerun, roll back, or delete jobs and pipelines. Every change is previewed with the nodes it reaches and a diff, and runs only after you confirm.
defaultPrompt: What jobs do I have on the network?
Which nodes are healthy and which are not?
How is the fleet doing today?
